agency: U.S. Department of Transportation, Bureau of Transportation Statistics
questions: truck crossings at the Texas-Mexico border by port
average domestic air fare by quarter

manual.how: Open the dataset page (https://data.bts.gov/d/<id>, e.g. https://data.bts.gov/d/crem-w557), choose Export > CSV, and upload the file; or open the CSV links in INSTRUCTIONS.md.

cache.why: Queries are small and the monthly series are revised each release; data/ is reused within a run.

redistribution.why: BTS statistics are U.S. government works in the public domain (17 U.S.C. 105); BTS asks for source attribution.

citation: Bureau of Transportation Statistics, {dataset}, data.bts.gov (Socrata API), retrieved {retrieved_long}.
clarify: Seasonally adjusted or not? Monthly Transportation Statistics carries both versions of airline traffic and transit ridership in different columns.
Border crossings: which measure (Trucks, Personal Vehicles, Personal Vehicle Passengers, Pedestrians, ...) and which border? Counts are inbound only.
